description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_URIScheme' responsible for validating URI components for a specific URI scheme within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties related to URI scheme characteristics and a method to validate URI instances.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme
classes.description: A class that encapsulates validation logic and properties for a URI scheme, including default port, browseability, and hierarchy status.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the components of a URI instance, adjusting the port if it matches the default port.
